entities.summary: Yuri Nikolayevich Baluyevsky is a retired Russian general of the army who served as Chief of the General Staff of the Russian Armed Forces and First Deputy Minister of Defense from 2004 to 2008. He was also a deputy secretary of the Security Council of Russia from 2008 to 2012.
